 Completeness: All attributes of the source tables should be covered
 Correctness: All data should be represented semantically correct
 Minimality: The integrated schema should be minimal in respect to the number of tables and attributes (redundancy-free)
 Understandability: The schema should be easy to understand.

 You split the schema integration process into three steps: 1. Merge the attributes which correspond together and output for each group/entity type the overall merged attributes. 4. Determine primary/foreign keys between table types (if there exist more than one table type) and add tables if necessary to model the relationship between table types.
